Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott

Class OttLinkFactory

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott.OttLinkFactory
@Component public final class OttLinkFactory extends Object
Builds the magic link of a token. It points at the confirmation page (GET /login/ott/confirm), whose button posts the token, and never at an endpoint that consumes it, so a mail scanner that opens the link does not use it up. The host is the configured issuer of this server, never the Host header of the request that asked for the link, which an attacker controls: a link built from it could carry the token of somebody else to another host.
